scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructs normalized spectral series, differentiated group velocity, Tauberian scaling and uniform moving-parameter bounds; numerical quadrature corroborates but cannot prove infinite-time limits.
scientific_limitations: Exact asymptotics for the specified continuum diagonal kinetic spectral integral only; not an exact theorem of full microscopic current, finite-size conductivity, or stochastic noise contributions. Published-source priority is not independently certified.
title: Marginal inverse-cube transport and a two-parameter logarithmic crossover
